enabled_policies.description: Enable/disable specific policy pages at this level Example: {"privacy_policy": true, "refund_policy": false}

policy_urls.description: Override policy URLs for this entity Example: {"terms_of_service": "/custom-terms"}

custom_policies.description: Custom policy pages unique to this entity Example: {"api_terms": "/api/terms"} for API projects

hidden_policies.description: Hide policies from navigation/footer while keeping them accessible Example: ["refund_policy", "dpa"] for non-commerce sites

inherit_parent_policies.description: Whether to inherit parent's policy configuration (default: true) Set to false to completely override parent settings

PolicyOverrides.title: Policy Overrides
PolicyOverrides.description: Policy page overrides for domain/blog/project level control Provides granular control over which policies are shown and their URLs See ../SCHEMA-ORG-EXAMPLES.md#policy-inheritance for examples
